reason: I'd probably start the free trial since there's no auto-charge and the data stays on my phone, but I've never paid for a sleep app. Free YouTube with a 30-minute timer works well enough, so in a normal month I wouldn't pay after day 14.
objection: It says the records never leave my phone, which is good, but I'm still trusting an app that watches my phone and movement all night. And honestly YouTube costs me nothing. Paying 4,900 a month just to fade out the sound and resume it when I wake at 3am is hard to justify on my salary.
would_change_my_mind: If the 14-day report clearly showed I fall back asleep a lot faster after waking at 3-4am with the resume button, I'd consider the 39,000 won yearly plan.
